data.title: Missing man found drowned after two-day search in Korat
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - The body of a 39-year-old man reported missing since Sunday has been found floating in a pond near his home in Non Sung district of this northeastern province.

data.title: Thai schools hold shooting response drills
data.description: Thai ⁠schools ⁠conducted active shooter drills on ​Wednesday, as authorities moved to strengthen security measures two ​weeks after a 14-year-old opened ‌fire at a school in Nonthaburi and killed seven people including himself, after killing his grandparents earlier.

data.title: Thailand considers firearms amnesty
data.description: <p>The Thai government is considering allowing people to surrender illegally held firearms without facing criminal charges as part of tighter gun controls.</p>

data.title: Thailand seeks new path to end deadly southern insurgency, negotiator says
data.description: Thailand is ready to shift its approach to a slow-burn insurgency ‌in its Muslim-majority deep south and revitalise a peace process, Bangkok's chief negotiator said, as violence simmers in one of Southeast Asia's longest-running conflicts.

data.title: Flash floods and landslides warnings for northern provinces
data.description: The Thai Meteorological Department has predicted heavy rainfall in the North and the Northeast until Friday and warns of run-offs, flash floods and landslides in several provinces.

data.title: Heavy rain in Nan triggers floods, roads cut by overflow
data.description: Heavy rainfall has triggered flash floods and overflow from Nan river in several districts of Nan province have inundated homes and rendered several roads impassable.

data.title: Heavy rain in Nan triggers floods, while rivers overflow making roads impassable
data.description: Heavy rainfall has triggered flash floods and the Nan river has overflowed in several districts of Nan province, inundating homes and several roads are impassable.

data.title: Leftover munition wounds six Thais in Israel
data.description: A leftover munition wounded six Thai migrant workers in Israel, two of them seriously, when it detonated on Tuesday in an agricultural field in the Metula area on the country's border with Lebanon.

data.title: Eastern Economic Corridor expansion plan 'must be transparent'
data.description: <p>Opposition leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has called on Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to ensure transparency over the proposed expansion of the Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC) into Prachin Buri province.</p>

data.title: Consumer protection board ramps up plane seat inquiry
data.description: <p>Prime Minister's Office Minister Supamas Isarabhakdi has ordered the Office of the Consumer Protection Board (OCPB) to broaden its probe into airline overbooking after a passenger was denied boarding despite checking in on time.</p>

data.title: Cabinet backs new labour protections
data.description: <p>The cabinet has approved four labour measures aimed at closing legal gaps and expanding protections for seafarers, home-based workers and state enterprise employees following the implementation of the marriage equality law.</p>

data.title: Anutin miffed at 2.2% GDP growth forecast
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas have said Thailand's projected 2.2% economic growth this year is still far from satisfactory, arguing that the country should aim for growth of 3-6%.</p>

data.title: Akanat defends energy permanent secretary pick
data.description: <p>Energy Minister Akanat Promphan has defended Chantanon Wannakejohn's appointment as permanent secretary, rejecting claims it was politically motivated.</p>

data.title: PP urges EC to send senate election case to top court
data.description: <p>The main opposition People's Party (PP) has urged the Election Commission (EC) to refer a case involving alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election to the Supreme Court, warning that the poll agency's credibility is already "almost gone".</p>

data.title: Anutin pitches Asean gateway
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has urged Australian businesses to invest in Thailand, touting the nation as a gateway to the 700-million-strong Asean market.</p>

data.title: Swiss citizen hands back lost Ban Chiang artefacts
data.description: <p>A Swiss national has handed over a collection of artefacts believed to be from the Ban Chiang archaeological site in Udon Thani to the Thai embassy in Bern for verification before their return to Thailand.</p>

data.title: Bottlenecks at Suvarnabhumi targeted before high season
data.description: <p>Deputy Prime Minister Suphajee Suthumpun has ordered urgent action to ease bottlenecks facing arriving passengers at Suvarnabhumi International Airport, targeting delays at immigration, baggage collection and on public transport.</p>

data.title: Pardon rules under review
data.description: <p>Critics have questioned the fairness of Thailand's justice system after the early release of former drug lord Laota Saenlee, whose life sentence was reduced to less than 10 years.</p>

data.title: Bangkok fitness coach dies after collapsing at Hyrox event
data.description: Bangkok-based fitness coach Leroy Saunders has died after collapsing and losing consciousness during the Hyrox Bangkok 2026 competition last Thursday, his family said on Tuesday.

data.title: Death toll from Bangkok pub fire rises to 41
data.description: Two more people have succumbed to injuries suffered in a fire at a Bangkok beer hall last month, bringing the death toll to 41, authorities said on Tuesday.
